body.x: LILLYCOVER has presented MUILLI, a device for skin diagnosis through multi-sensor, in front of 150 guests in the industry and foreign media at the event MIK Innovation Night 2019 on January 10, which was held during CES 2019, the world’s largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA.

LILLYCOVER is a specialized company in ICT-combined product and beauty total solution, which received attention for attracting investment in Silicon Valley; its self-developed MUILLI is a hand-held type of device that can connect to the mobile application.

The device can self-diagnose skin by enlarging the skin image 60 times through multi-sensor installed in a camera lens, and it provides 3-steps total solution, massage technology for skin regeneration inducement through atmospheric plasma technology, diversified skin diagnosis through camera and sensor, and real-time skin management through a mobile application.

Based on the result of the diagnosis, it divides the skin into 40 different skin types and provides quest for skin care and information through environmental analysis about skin exposure, and skin regeneration inducement technology through 3-steps of plasma massage.

The measured factor is analyzed through the algorithm, and its result can be monitored directly to the user by connecting the device to the mobile application. It does not only provide self-care method depending on skin type but also a connection to a specialist.

Since plasma technology is applied to the device, it is safer than existing treatment plans which is based on physical stimulation such as MTS (Microneedle Therapy System), razor, biochemicals. Also, it provides a role of linking customer purchase with a supply of specialist recommended product through M-commerce service.

Seonhui An, The CEO of the company, said “The company’s aim is extending towards providing motivation to users for beautiful skin management,” and added that “They will progress on the meeting that will connect to skin-diagnose result with Johnson & Johnson, and will cooperate with other various global beauty-brand companies.”
